invoices.emailFailed: The email could not be sent

invoices.exchangeRateRequired: Invoicing in a foreign currency requires the exchange rate
invoices.noKudeYet: The KuDE is generated once SIFEN approves the document
invoices.invalidLines: Check the lines: quantity and price must be greater than zero

invoices.queuedOk: Document issued and queued for sending to SIFEN
invoices.contingencyBanner: This document is in contingency: SIFEN was unreachable. It is retried automatically.
invoices.rejectedBanner: SIFEN rejected this document. Fix the data and resend it.
invoices.newDocFromRejected: A new draft was created with the same data. The rejected document stays in the history.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.uploadHint: Drag photos or PDFs here, or take a picture with your phone. JPG, PNG or PDF — several at once.
expenses.empty: You don't have any expenses yet
expenses.reviewHint: Amber fields have low confidence — check them against the image.
expenses.categoryRemembered: Remembered for the next upload from this supplier
expenses.duplicateWarning: Possible duplicate: an expense from the same supplier with the same number, date and total already exists
expenses.totalsMismatch: Careful: taxed + VAT + exempt ({sum}) does not match the total ({total})
expenses.rucInvalid: The RUC check digit does not match
expenses.dateOdd: The date looks out of range
expenses.noApiKey: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set — automatic extraction is disabled. You can still enter the expense manually.
expenses.noItemsHint: No items loaded: a single deductibility % applies to the whole expense.
expenses.itemsMismatch: The sum of the items does not match the receipt total
expenses.importHint: Upload the electronic/virtual receipts CSV/XLSX exported from Marangatu ('Consulta de comprobantes'). Duplicates are detected automatically by RUC + number + date + total.
expenses.importResult: {created} expenses created, {skipped} duplicates skipped, {errors} rows with errors

cdcCheck.title: Verify a comprobante with DNIT
cdcCheck.hint: Paste the 44-digit CDC of the electronic document you received. We validate it locally first, then ask SIFEN whether the document exists and is approved.

verdict.verified: Verified: SIFEN confirms the document and it matches what was captured.
verdict.rejected: Rejected: SIFEN does not consider this document valid.
verdict.mismatch: Does not match: the document exists, but it is not the one captured here.
verdict.unknown: No answer: we could not confirm it with SIFEN.

finding.cdc_bad_check_digit: The CDC's check digit does not add up — look for a missing or extra number.
finding.matches_expense: Matches the captured expense ({checks} fields checked).
finding.ruc_mismatch: The issuer's RUC does not match: captured {captured}, in the CDC {cdc}.
finding.numero_mismatch: The document number does not match: captured {captured}, in the CDC {cdc}.
finding.fecha_mismatch: The date does not match: captured {captured}, in the CDC {cdc} (the CDC carries the issue date).
finding.tipo_mismatch: The document type does not match.

cdcCheck.failed: The query could not be completed.

expenses.xmlHint: Upload the XML of the electronic documents issued to you (you download them from Marangatú). We validate the CDC and, if you already captured the expense from a photo, we merge them instead of duplicating.
expenses.xmlFile: Drag the .xml files here, or click to choose them
expenses.xmlResult: {created} new · {merged} merged with expenses already captured · {skipped} already imported · {conflicts} with differences · {foreign} for another RUC · {errors} failed

xmlError.no_de: The file contains no electronic document (DE).
xmlError.cdc_invalid: The CDC is not valid: its check digit does not add up.
xmlError.cdc_mismatch: The document's contents disagree with its own CDC.
xmlError.missing_fields: The document is missing required data (issuer, number or date).

expenses.conflictsHint: Some electronic documents disagree on the amounts with expenses you already confirmed. We did not touch the confirmed figures: a note was left on each expense for you to review.

books.title: VAT books
books.onlyApproved: Only approved documents and confirmed expenses are included

reports.title: Reports
reports.noData: No data for the selected period

settings.title: Settings
settings.companyHint: Fiscal data included in every electronic document
settings.timbradoDateEndHint: Optional. If you fill it in, we email you 60, 30 and 7 days before it expires.
settings.certificateHint: The .p12 is stored encrypted. It signs documents in test/production mode.
settings.sifenModeHint: The mode is set with the server's SIFEN_MODE environment variable. Change it and restart the app.
settings.smtpHint: Used to send the KuDE and XML to your clients. Configured via SMTP_* environment variables.
settings.backupHint: A database + files backup is generated nightly. The last 14 are kept.
settings.backupOperatorOnly: This instance serves several companies: the full backup contains all of their data, so only the operator downloads it from the server. The nightly backup is still generated.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.form120Hint: Working draft — not the official form. Load these figures into Marangatu.
taxes.saldoAnteriorHint: Manually enter the credit balance carried over from the previous Form 120.
taxes.reconciliationClean: No pending documents. The period is ready to close.
taxes.reconciliationDirty: There are unresolved documents — review them before closing the period.
taxes.unresolvedInvoices: Invoices not yet approved by SIFEN
taxes.sequenceGapsHint: Numbers the sequence handed out with nothing to show for them. They do not block the close — a burned number cannot be recovered — but it is worth having the explanation ready for DNIT.
taxes.closeBlockedHint: Resolve the pending documents before closing the period.
taxes.draftPrepared: Draft prepared automatically on {date} — review it and close the period.
taxes.filingLockedHint: This filing was already submitted to DNIT: its figures are frozen and cannot be reopened or re-closed.

history.title: Filing history
history.emptyDescription: Once you close a period in Taxes it will appear here with its receipt.
history.replaceReceiptHint: Replacing stores a new file; the previous one is never deleted.
history.closeFirstHint: Close the period before marking it submitted or paid.
history.snapshotHint: These figures were frozen when the period was closed. Later edits to invoices or expenses do not change them.

error.not_found: Filing not found, or that transition is not allowed.
error.bad_type: The receipt must be a PDF.
error.unreadable: The file could not be read.

irp.title: IRP — annual return
irp.hint: Working draft — not the official form. Enter these figures into the IRP return inside Marangatu.
irp.regimeNotSet: You have not declared which IRP regime you are taxed under. Pick the one that applies: the calculation and the close depend on it, and we do not assume it.
irp.regimePreview: You are previewing the {regime} regime. Save the regime that applies to you before closing the year.
irp.regimeStub: The RGC rules were never confirmed against the law: what you see is scaffolding that keeps the calculation regime-parameterized, not a return ready to file. Closing is disabled for this regime.
irp.ratesUnverified: The IRP rate scale is taken from secondary sources and has not yet been verified against the DNIT text. Verify it before the first return you file.
irp.ivaFacturado: VAT invoiced (collected for the State — not income)
irp.egresoNoDeducible: Non-deductible expenses (excluded by the item-by-item review)
irp.noRegimeDeduction: This regime does not deduct expenses
irp.brackets: The scale applied, bracket by bracket
irp.noIncidido: Gross income for the year does not exceed {threshold} Gs., so no tax is due. The formal obligations still stand.
irp.deducibilityProxy: The deductible share comes from the item-by-item VAT deducibility review. That is not the same legal test as IRP deducibility: review the expenses before declaring.
irp.reconciliationClean: No pending documents across the twelve months. The year is ready to close.
irp.reconciliationDirty: There are unresolved documents in this year — review them before closing.
irp.closeBlockedHint: Resolve the year's pending documents before closing it.
irp.documentCounts: {ventas} sales · {compras} purchases · {meses} of 12 months with activity

taxes.inactiveSuppliers: Suppliers not active in the padrón
taxes.inactiveSuppliersHint: Confirmed purchases whose supplier the DNIT padrón lists with a status other than ACTIVO as of {date}. That is today's status, not the one on the invoice date: check whether the purchase predates the change. It does not block the close.

documents.title: Documents
documents.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, note or uploader...
documents.fileHint: PDF, image or spreadsheet, up to 20 MB. Documents are never deleted.
documents.emptyDescription: Upload bank statements, DNIT notices, contracts or certificates. Filing receipts show up here on their own.

error.bad_type: That file type is not accepted.
error.too_large: The file is larger than 20 MB.
error.failed: The document could not be uploaded.

filing_due.subject: {company} — VAT for period {detail} is due on {date}
filing_due.body:
Reminder: the VAT return (Formulario 120) for period {detail} is due on {date}.

Open Taxes to review the draft and close the period. The draft is a working document — you file it in Marangatu yourself.

timbrado_expiry.subject: {company} — timbrado {detail} expires on {date}
timbrado_expiry.body:
Reminder: your timbrado {detail} expires on {date}.

Renew it with DNIT before that date; without a valid timbrado you cannot issue electronic documents.

cert_expiry.subject: {company} — your digital certificate expires on {date}
cert_expiry.body:
Reminder: the digital certificate you use to sign electronic documents expires on {date}.

Renew it with your provider and upload the new .p12 file in Settings before that date.

close_report.subject: {company} — monthly report for period {detail}
close_report.body:
Attached is the monthly report for period {detail}, closed and signed off by a named person.

It covers the sales and purchase summary, the VAT position, and the figures to enter in Formulario 120.

notifications.footer: This is an automatic notice from FacturaPY. Please do not reply to this email.
